import json,runpy,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
E=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
R=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/IdeaProjects/zee-urunlesme-20261014')
H=runpy.run_path(str(R/'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'))
out=E/'s4-post-rc-owned-awake.json'
stop=E/'s4-post-rc-owned-awake.stop'
assert not out.exists() and not stop.exists()
start=time.monotonic()
child=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/caffeinate','-i','-m','-s','-t','3600'],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True,close_fds=True)
reason='deadline'
try:
 while H['held_status'](child) is None and time.monotonic()-start<3600:
  if stop.exists(): reason='owned-stop-file';break
  time.sleep(1)
finally:
 H['stop_owned'](child,grace=3)
 out.write_text(json.dumps({'schema':'zee-temporary-owned-awake-1','source_sha':'4b7dd76ad5e10bdf1b16bded82b3ea20ad55a9e2','status':'closed-owned-utility','utility':'/usr/bin/caffeinate','argv':['-i','-m','-s','-t','3600'],'bounded_seconds':3600,'reason':reason,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'owned_original_Popen_reaped':True,'permanent_preference_changed':False},indent=2)+'\n')
